integrity: An analytic proof and a reproducible finite-state checker are provided; no independent audit or originality certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Uniform-edge-priority dimer adsorption on the cocktail-party graph only; a vertex-first algorithm may have a different distribution. Finite-n recurrence is exact, asymptotic error exponent need not be optimal. No theorem about deposition times or general graphs. Older potentially relevant complete texts were unavailable.
title: A three-quarters rare-jamming constant for dimers on cocktail-party graphs
